providers.providerName: Federal Reserve Economic Data and Archival FRED
providers.licensePolicy: Archive Federal Reserve H.15 MPRIME and GS3M responses locally with FRED and Board of Governors attribution; retain NFCI only as diagnostic evidence under its existing local-research restriction; Moody's BAA remains excluded.

series.endpointSemantics: Enumerate /fred/series/vintagedates through the frozen as-of date, then request /fred/series/observations with series_id=MPRIME, file_type=json, units=lin, sort_order=asc, output_type=3, and deterministic batches of exactly 100 vintage dates except the final remainder; reconstruct real-time intervals from returned change events.
series.fieldSemantics: Monthly Bank Prime Loan Rate from the Federal Reserve Board H.15 release, percent per annum; it is the credit-rate numerator in the frozen spread.
series.publicationBehavior: A value is admitted only when its ALFRED real-time start is at or before the forecast cutoff.
series.revisionBehavior: Retain all returned real-time intervals; later revisions cannot overwrite a pinned earlier vintage.
series.licenseRestriction: Federal Reserve Board H.15 public data; FRED API terms and attribution still apply; no raw redistribution from this project.
series.missingnessPolicy: The spread is unavailable unless MPRIME and GS3M share an observation month and both values were published by cutoff; no interpolation or one-sided carry-forward.
series.decisionReason: Official metadata and non-persisting probes returned 440 monthly observations over 1990-2026 and 359 ALFRED vintages beginning 1996-12-03, providing adequate point-in-time coverage without the Moody's storage restriction.

series.endpointSemantics: Enumerate /fred/series/vintagedates through the frozen as-of date, then request /fred/series/observations with series_id=GS3M, file_type=json, units=lin, sort_order=asc, output_type=3, and deterministic batches of exactly 100 vintage dates except the final remainder; reconstruct real-time intervals from returned change events.
series.fieldSemantics: Monthly market yield on three-month constant-maturity U.S. Treasury securities, investment basis, percent per annum; it is the risk-free denominator in the frozen spread.
series.publicationBehavior: A value is admitted only when its ALFRED real-time start is at or before the forecast cutoff.
series.revisionBehavior: Retain all returned real-time intervals; later revisions cannot overwrite a pinned earlier vintage.
series.licenseRestriction: Federal Reserve Board H.15 public data; FRED API terms and attribution still apply; no raw redistribution from this project.
series.missingnessPolicy: The spread is unavailable unless MPRIME and GS3M share an observation month and both values were published by cutoff; no interpolation or one-sided carry-forward.
series.decisionReason: Official metadata and non-persisting probes returned 440 monthly observations over 1990-2026 and 359 ALFRED vintages beginning 1996-12-03, matching MPRIME's vintage boundary and supporting deterministic same-month alignment.

series.endpointSemantics: Historical v2 ALFRED capture retained as diagnostic evidence only; it is not reacquired into or consumed by the v3 core dataset.
series.fieldSemantics: Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index, weekly ending Friday; positive values indicate tighter-than-average conditions and negative values looser-than-average conditions.
series.publicationBehavior: ALFRED exposes no vintage before 2011-05-25, regardless of the reconstructed observation-history start.
series.revisionBehavior: The complete curve is revised as inputs and weights change; only pinned v2 vintage records may be used diagnostically.
series.licenseRestriction: Copyrighted, citation required; local nonredistributed research only under the source download offering and site terms.
series.missingnessPolicy: Never backfill pre-2011 forecast cutoffs from a later reconstructed curve and never substitute NFCI into a promotion-eligible v4 feature.
series.decisionReason: The first ALFRED vintage is 2011-05-25; after the frozen normalization warm-up it yielded only 147 labeled rows, below the immutable 228-row gate.

runtimeCoverageGates.confirmationResolutionRule: For each instrument, reserve the final 96 months with complete 12-month labels after all core-source coverage gates pass; record exact dates in the dataset manifest without changing scientific fields.

protectedFieldPolicy: Preregistration v4 changes only the two NFCI-derived feature definitions to the MPRIME-minus-GS3M spread level and three-month change. Targets, states, models, partitions, promotion gates, thresholds, seeds, decision vocabulary, no-HMM rule and ten-evaluation budget remain unchanged.
